viewing_check: Check species: sniff a fresh scratch or cut for the strong resinous Huon pine scent, look for fine tight grain, pale gold colour, and any dark knots. Measure length, width and thickness, and check for rot, splits or worm. If no Huon smell, it is likely celery top or similar and sits at the low end ($30 to $60).
